title: A Great Buy!
text: A Great Buy!. Because we have multiple older ladies in our church, I purchased 10 of these for them use as lap robes.  They are lightweight but warm, and the gray color was true to what was pictured.

product_metadata.title: Reafort Ultra Soft Flannel Fleece All Season Light Weight Living Room/Bedroom Warm Throw Blanket(Purple, Full/Queen 90"X92")
features: OkeoTex certified. Safe to use. 100% high quality super soft polyester microfiber.
this plush blanket is super soft, durable, and lightweight. It's wrinkle and fade resistant, doesn't shed, and is suitable for all seasons
All seasons velvet/royal plush/micro fleece throw can be used as an accent on sofas and chairs. Over-sized blankets give you great cover for the beds; It is a gift gift for all occasions.
Machine wash in cold water with similar colors, air dry or tumble dry low. Do not bleach.
